entries.estimatedFrom: Cleveland Board of Education v. Loudermill, 470 U.S. 532 (1985); Minn. Stat. chapter 43A
entries.method: Modal compiled permanent classified service coverage; median recorded notice, filing and reinstatement terms. One compiled numerical sample is currently available.
entries.missing: Compile each jurisdiction’s actual employee-class coverage, appeal forum, deadlines, collective agreements, selection rules and pay plans.
entries.limitation: The source dates remain binding for compiled observations. Estimated terms do not establish an individual official’s authority, tenure, employment class or agreement coverage.
